stories.title: Sources: Gonzalez lands record deal with Patriots
stories.summary: The Patriots and Christian Gonzalez agreed to terms on a four-year, $135 million extension that makes him the highest-paid CB in NFL history.

stories.title: Jennings, SMU overcome miscues, delay, top FSU
stories.summary: SMU quarterback Kevin Jennings shook off a pair of interceptions to lead the No. 19 Mustangs' winning scoring drive, capped by Nick Reed's 20-yard field goal with 21 seconds to play, and the road team wrapped up a 27-24 win over Florida State on Monday.

stories.title: Ohtani: 'Most likely' won't pitch again this season
stories.summary: Shohei Ohtani, who returned to the Dodgers' lineup Monday, said he is "focusing on hitting moving forward."

stories.title: Judge, out since May 31, activated by Yankees
stories.summary: The New York Yankees activated three-time American League MVP Aaron Judge, 34, on Monday night, paving the way for his return against the Colorado Rockies on Tuesday after sitting out more than three months because of a fractured rib.

stories.title: Bosa to face Rams; Kittle trending that way too
stories.summary: All signs point toward San Francisco's Nick Bosa and George Kittle playing in Thursday's season opener versus the Rams.
